data.long_meaning: In Spanish culture, Quintana refers to the fifth estate, representing the power of the Church. In Latin, quintus means fifth, which could also apply to the fifth daughter in a family. The name Quintana carries the meaning “Fifth estate, fifth daughter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
